I am writing regarding the deposit deduction notice received for Nakatia 1bhk. I dispute several proposed deductions.

The deduction for carpet cleaning (₹250) is disputed as no evidence of the carpet's condition at move-in or move-out, or the necessity for excessive cleaning, has been provided. The wall repainting charge (₹600) is disputed because no evidence of intentional damage, unauthorized painting, or damage beyond normal wear and tear has been presented, as required by the lease. Finally, the trash removal deduction (₹150) is disputed due to a lack of evidence demonstrating unremoved belongings or trash at move-out, and no invoice for the service has been provided.

Therefore, I am disputing a total of ₹1,000 from the security deposit. I request a revised refund breakdown or the full disputed amount of ₹1,000 to be returned within 7 days from the date of this message. If I do not receive a response or a satisfactory resolution within this timeframe, I will follow up in writing.

DepositBack helps organise evidence and draft communication. It does not provide legal representation and does not guarantee any outcome.
